zh.title: 台灣民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會 聚焦韌性與智慧化
zh.summary: 民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會；聚焦保安韌性智慧化與桃園機場貨運保安
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月14日舉辦「2026航空保安研討會」，邀集產官學界代表共同參與。本次研討會旨在因應全球新型態威脅並提升台灣航空保安實力，聚焦於保安韌性與智慧化等關鍵議題。
研討會圍繞四大主題進行討論，包括全球航空保安韌性、機場保安智慧化、深植保安文化，以及桃園國際機場（TPE）新貨運園區貨物保安展望。與會代表包含運輸安全委員會、航空警察局、桃園國際機場公司及長榮空儲等單位代表。
民航局局長何淑萍於致詞時表示，航空保安需要主管機關、警察機關與業界緊密結合。她指出，韌性意指事件發生時快速恢復的能力，恢復時間越短代表韌性越強，需要體系中各崗位人員共同努力與設備智慧化精進。

en.title: CAA Taiwan Hosts 2026 Aviation Security Symposium Focusing on Resilience and Smart Technology
en.summary: CAA Taiwan hosted the 2026 Aviation Security Symposium, focusing on security resilience and smart airport technologies.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan hosted the 2026 Aviation Security Symposium on August 14, 2026. The event brought together industry and official representatives to share operational insights, respond to evolving global threats, and strengthen domestic aviation security capabilities.

Discussions focused on four core themes: global aviation security resilience, smart airport security, embedding a strong security culture, and the cargo security outlook for the new cargo park at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). Participants included representatives from the Taiwan Transportation Safety Board, the Aviation Police Bureau, Taoyuan International Airport Corporation, and Evergreen Air Cargo Services.

CAA Director General Ho Shu-ping stated that aviation security requires close coordination between the civil aviation authority, police forces, and industry partners. She emphasized that security resilience refers to the ability to recover rapidly from incidents, requiring ongoing hardware smartification and commitment from personnel across all roles.

zh.title: 埃特納火山噴發影響 義大利卡塔尼亞機場（CTA）關閉延長至週六
zh.summary: 埃特納火山噴發持續；義大利西西里卡塔尼亞機場關閉時間延長至星期六
body: 根據路透社報導，位於義大利西西里島的卡塔尼亞機場，因埃特納火山噴發影響，機場關閉時間已進一步延長至星期六。火山噴發活動持續進行，導致該機場無法按原訂時程恢復正常的航空營運。
先前報導指出，埃特納火山噴發出的火山灰，最初導致卡塔尼亞機場持續關閉至星期五，並對當地的夏季旅遊交通造成了顯著的干擾與中斷。
隨著埃特納火山噴發持續，卡塔尼亞機場保持關閉狀態，前往與離開西西里島卡塔尼亞的夏季旅遊航空交通持續受到影響。

en.title: Etna Eruption Extends Catania Airport (CTA) Closure in Sicily Until Saturday
en.summary: Catania airport in Sicily extends operational closure until Saturday following continued eruption of Etna.
body: According to reporting by Reuters, an eruption of Mount Etna has forced the extended closure of Sicily's Catania airport until Saturday. The continuation of volcanic activity has prevented the facility from resuming regular air transport operations as previously anticipated.

Previous reporting noted that volcanic ash generated by Mount Etna had initially kept Catania airport shut through Friday. The presence of airborne volcanic ash caused disruptions to summer travel across the affected region in Italy.
With the ongoing Etna eruption prolonging the airport shutdown into Saturday, summer travel operations serving Catania and Sicily continue to face operational disruptions.

zh.title: 美國國家航空暨太空總署亮相改裝波音777空中實驗室
zh.summary: 美國太空總署展示波音777空中實驗室，接替退役DC-8執行大氣科研任務
body: 美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）正式公開其最新引進的波音（Boeing）777-200ER空中科研實驗室。該架客機改裝後的國籍標誌暨登記號碼為N577NA，並於2026年8月12日首度揭曉全新的NASA主題外觀塗裝，隨後返回位於維吉尼亞州的太空總署蘭利研究中心（Langley Research Centre）。此架大型噴射機將成為美國國家航空暨太空總署未來大氣與地球科學研究的核心空中平台。
新引進的波音777-200ER旨在接替並擴充先前DC-8-72科研機的任務功能。太空總署原先使用的道格拉斯（Douglas）DC-8空中實驗室在服役長達37年後，已於2024年正式退役。先前DC-8曾支援包含大氣化學、氣象學、海洋學、火山學、生物學、水文學及考古學等多領域的研究專案，而全新的波音777飛機將具備更遠的航程能力，提供廣泛的全球科研資料收集支援。
根據相關規劃，這架波音777空中實驗室將由太空總署蘭利研究中心負責營運，主要支援多個美國政府機關的大氣科研計畫，以及各項環境與航空相關研究。該機的科研任務包括新感測器開發、衛星感測器校正、科學資料校驗，以及各類地球系統過程的實地觀測，協助研究團隊提升氣候與環境模型的精準度，以利政策決策制定。
該架飛機最初於2003年製造出廠，生產序號為32892，最初交付予日本航空（Japan Airlines）營運，當時國籍編號為JA704J，直至2020年5月自商業客運退役並封存。其後，該機由位於南加州的Logistic Air公司收購並重新登記為N774LG，最終由太空總署選中購得。選擇該機型的主因包含其優異的長程飛行能力、相對年輕的機齡，以及現代化的航電系統與科技。
這架飛機的重度改裝工程於2025年啟動，由位於德克薩斯州韋科（Waco）的L3Harris Technologies公司負責執行。改裝內容包含安裝多個機腹下視（nadir）與機窗感測器開口、資料與通訊系統、電力升級以及儀器操作員席位配置。太空總署預計該架波音777空中實驗室將於2027年初正式投入首次科研飛行營運任務。

en.title: NASA Unveils Modified Boeing 777 Airborne Lab as Replacement for DC-8
en.summary: NASA has unveiled its new Boeing 777 airborne research laboratory to replace the retired DC-8 aircraft.
body: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) has officially unveiled its newly acquired modified Boeing 777-200ER widebody jet, which will serve as the agency's new airborne research laboratory. Carrying registration N577NA, the aircraft was presented on August 12 showcasing a new NASA-themed livery before returning to the NASA Langley Research Centre in Virginia.

The new Boeing 777-200ER has been acquired to replace and expand upon the capabilities of NASA's previous Douglas DC-8-72 airborne laboratory, which was retired in 2024 after 37 years of service. During its operational history, the predecessor DC-8 supported atmospheric chemistry, meteorology, oceanography, volcanology, biology, and hydrology missions. The Boeing 777's extended range will provide global reach for future data collection projects.

Based at NASA's Langley Research Centre in Virginia, the aircraft will support various atmospheric projects for multiple United States government agencies, alongside environmental and aerospace research. Planned scientific missions include sensor development, satellite sensor calibration, data product validation, and field studies on Earth system processes to improve scientific models.

Originally manufactured in 2003 with serial number 32892, the Boeing 777-246(ER) was delivered to Japan Airlines and operated commercial flights under registration JA704J until its retirement in May 2020. The jet was later acquired by Southern California-based Logistic Air as N774LG before NASA selected the platform for its age, modern avionics, and long-range capabilities.

Extensive retrofitting began in 2025, conducted by L3Harris Technologies in Waco, Texas. Current modification work includes installing nadir and window instrument ports, enhanced power and communications systems, and specialized accommodations for instrument operators. NASA expects the aircraft to begin its initial scientific flight operations in early 2027.

zh.title: 印度空軍啟動150架高級教練機替換計畫
zh.summary: 印度空軍發布資訊需求書；採購約150架高級教練機；回覆截止日為10月5日
body: 印度空軍已正式啟動替換現役Hawk Mk-132高級噴射教練機（AJT）的採購流程，預計尋求採購約150架Stage-III (F)階段高級教練機。該階段機型為印度空軍飛行訓練體系中的最後一環，旨在讓飛行員在銜接Rafale、Tejas等前線主力戰鬥機之前，熟悉先進航空電子與戰鬥系統。
印度空軍已針對本次教練機採購計畫，向印度國內及海外國防製造商發布資訊需求書（RFI），要求意願廠商於10月5日前提交回應文件。在收到製造商回覆後，後續預計於印度當地展開相關試飛與評測作業，該階段將以無須付費且不具強制承諾的形式進行。
現役的Hawk Mk-132教練機自2008年起即承擔印度空軍的高級訓練任務。印度過去曾分兩批次採購總計106架該型教練機，包括2004年簽署的首批66架合約，以及2010年向印度國營國防企業印度航空工業公司（HAL）追加訂購的40架教練機。
目前該項採購計畫仍處於初期資料收集階段，暫定於2027年12月發布正式招標文件（RFP），隨後進行實機評估與試飛。由於相關合約要求在生效後60個月內完成全部交機，這批新型高級教練機預計不太可能在2030年代中期之前正式投入印度空軍服役。
在技術規格方面，印度空軍要求新型教練機配備線傳飛控系統（fly-by-wire）、玻璃座艙，以及可設定的手置節流閥與操縱桿（HOTAS）。導航系統需整合印度本土NavIC衛星導航以及GPS、GLONASS系統；安全配備則要求零零彈射椅、自動恢復飛行穩定功能，並嵌入虛擬航電與電子戰訓練套件。

en.title: Indian Air Force Begins Process to Procure 150 Advanced Jet Trainers
en.summary: Indian Air Force issues RFI for 150 advanced jet trainers; responses due October 5
body: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has initiated the process to replace its fleet of Hawk Mk-132 advanced jet trainers, seeking approximately 150 new Stage-III (F) trainer aircraft. The Stage-III (F) designation represents the final aircraft in the service's flying-training pipeline before student pilots transition to frontline operational fighters such as the Rafale, Tejas, and future combat aircraft.

To begin the procurement process, the Indian Air Force has issued an official Request for Information (RFI) to both domestic and international aircraft manufacturers, setting a submission deadline of October 5. Following the submission of manufacturer responses, evaluation flight trials will be conducted within India on a no-cost and no-commitment basis for the military service.

The Hawk Mk-132 aircraft has occupied the Indian Air Force's advanced jet training slot since 2008. India previously contracted for a total of 106 Hawk trainers across two separate procurement batches, comprising an initial 66-aircraft agreement signed in 2004 and a subsequent order for 40 additional units contracted from Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) in 2010.

The current procurement program remains in its preliminary stages prior to a final contract award. A formal Request for Proposal (RFP) is tentatively scheduled for release in December 2027, followed by comprehensive flight trials and evaluations. With aircraft deliveries expected to be completed within 60 months of contract implementation, the replacement jet trainers are unlikely to enter operational service before the mid-2030s.

The technical requirements outlined in the Request for Information specify fly-by-wire flight controls, a modern glass cockpit, and configurable hands-on-throttle-and-stick (HOTAS) controls. Additionally, navigation systems must integrate India's indigenous NavIC satellite navigation system alongside GPS and GLONASS, while safety standards require zero-zero ejection seats, automatic recovery capabilities from lost control, and embedded virtual avionics and electronic warfare suites.
